verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents its own capability to migrate user data into and out of the service, including bulk exports, and to export tenant logs through log streaming, so a first-party exit path exists. A hands-on community report says exports that include password hashes needed a support ticket, which limits self-service exit. missing for 10: documented open/standard export formats, evidence that ALL tenant data (configuration, roles, organizations, metadata) is exportable, self-service password-hash export, independent corroboration of a complete exit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Migrate your user data into and out of Auth0 with automatic migration and bulk imports and exports.
Auth0's log streaming service allows you to export tenant logs to a log analysis service.
They recalled needing to raise a support ticket to get an export that includes password hashes.
